scope: Numeric guards only, at finite poses: direction, real deformation of every stepped bone, triangle collapse, hand-region self and new cross-mesh intersections, hand edge-ratio guard, and a no-worse-than-baseline ratchet for the rest of the body (overlap at rest, pose-induced pairs and stretch). Weapon meshes are excluded here and judged by the grasp and clip gates. Not a continuous-range or art acceptance.
